'''Dmitry Olegovich Kramkov''' ({{langx|ru|Дмитрий Олегович Крамков}}) is a Russian [[mathematician]] at [[Carnegie Mellon University]]. His research field are [[statistics]] and [[financial mathematics]].

Kramkov obtained his [[doctorate]] from [[Steklov Institute of Mathematics]] in 1992, under supervision of [[Albert Shiryaev]]. In 1996 he was awarded an [[EMS Prize]] for his work in filtered statistical experiments.<ref>[http://www.emis.de/ECM2/prizes.html EMS Prizes]</ref>

[[Kramkov's optional decomposition theorem]] is named after him.
